quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Forgetting why you wanted something now that you have it — what emotion might cause this blank?
quests.explanation: Losing clarity about your own goal when an opportunity arrives is a sign of nervousness overriding reason.
quests.textToSpeak: I always thought I wanted this opportunity. Now that it's here, I can't seem to remember why.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Budget cuts followed six weeks later by a bonus scheme — what does this sequence reveal and produce?
quests.explanation: A budget justification exposed as false by subsequent spending on bonuses produces clear anger.
quests.textToSpeak: They cited budget constraints when they cut the program. Six weeks later they announced a staff bonus scheme.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A collective, unexplained workplace behavior that everyone follows without questioning — what does this produce?
quests.explanation: A universal, unexplained behavior adopted by an entire workplace naturally raises questions of curiosity.
quests.textToSpeak: Every employee in the building uses the fire exit stairwell to make calls. Nobody ever explains why. Everyone just does.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Not even the traffic' — what does including imperfect things in a perfect day tell you about the speaker?
quests.explanation: Including imperfect details in a perfect day suggests the speaker is so happy that everything felt right.
quests.textToSpeak: There wasn't a single moment of the entire day I'd have changed. Not the weather, not the company, not even the traffic.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Habits are slow to understand' — what situation does this describe, and what emotion does it carry?
quests.explanation: Setting two cups by habit after someone is gone is a quiet, daily reminder of loss that reflects sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: I still set two cups out in the morning. Some habits are slow to understand what's happened.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: An expert contradicted by discovery one week after their confident claim — what does the timing produce?
quests.explanation: Expert certainty followed by immediate contradiction is a cause of surprise and irony.
quests.textToSpeak: The scientist who told us the ocean floor was fully mapped was interviewed the week after a new species was discovered there.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: An eighty-slide deck opening with 'exciting times ahead' — what does the scale of the deck signal about the content?
quests.explanation: An enormous deck opening with a corporate cliché suggests the session produced quantity over substance — boredom.
quests.textToSpeak: The strategy offsite produced an eighty-slide deck that begins with the words 'exciting times ahead.'

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'This changes everything' after three years of minimal resources — what does full funding produce?
quests.explanation: Full grant funding after three years of surviving on minimal resources is a transformative source of excitement.
quests.textToSpeak: The grant came through for the full amount. We've been operating on a shoestring for three years — this changes everything.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Data over gut feelings after comprehensive modeling — what professional attitude does this express?
quests.explanation: Trusting your own comprehensive modeling over others' intuition reflects professional confidence.
quests.textToSpeak: Every outcome I modeled has us ahead. I'd rather bet on the data than the gut feelings in that room.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A recurring, unopened envelope on the same bench every week for a year — what does this pattern produce?
quests.explanation: A year of identical, recurring, unexplained behavior in a public place is a cause of deep curiosity.
quests.textToSpeak: Someone has been leaving one unopened envelope on the same park bench every Tuesday morning for over a year.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Another small ending' — what does this suggest about the number of small losses the speaker is navigating?
quests.explanation: Each practical step taken after a loss is described as a 'small ending,' accumulating sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: I cancelled my subscription to the magazine she used to read. It felt like another small ending.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Good-faith decisions made legal at the time being retroactively ruled non-compliant — what is this?
quests.explanation: Being held accountable under rules that didn't exist when you acted produces strong justified anger.
quests.textToSpeak: The policy was changed retroactively. Decisions we made in good faith are now being called non-compliant.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Nothing was happening and everything felt fine' — what does this quiet state of ease describe?
quests.explanation: Finding contentment in nothing happening and everything feeling fine is a description of simple happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: I sat in the park and watched the geese for an hour. Nothing was happening and everything felt fine.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Prior experience of difficulty not helping with a new kind of difficulty — what gap does this create?
quests.explanation: Prior experience being irrelevant to a specific new challenge produces nervousness and uncertainty.
quests.textToSpeak: I've handled grief before, but I've never had to tell a child something like this. I don't know how to start.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A three-year-old conversation you had forgotten having a major long-term impact — what is this?
quests.explanation: Finding out that a long-forgotten conversation significantly redirected someone's career is genuinely surprising.
quests.textToSpeak: She said she'd thought about our conversation from three years ago and it had changed the direction of her career.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Four hours of training for a badge saying 'Compliance Achieved' — what does this reward structure signal?
quests.explanation: A four-hour investment for a trivial achievement badge is a description of obligatory, soul-draining boredom.
quests.textToSpeak: The compliance training takes four hours and rewards completion with a badge that says 'Compliance Achieved.'

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A daily, perfectly consistent signal drop at exactly one location — what does this anomaly make you wonder?
quests.explanation: An impossibly consistent daily anomaly at a precise location produces curiosity about the cause.
quests.textToSpeak: The signal on my device drops at exactly the same spot on my commute every single day without exception.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Eleven months of review with no communication and no accessible contact — what emotion has this produced?
quests.explanation: Eleven months of administrative silence with no way to reach anyone produces sustained anger.
quests.textToSpeak: My tax return has been under review for eleven months with no update and no reachable point of contact.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Good quiet' in a place that was previously painful — what does that shift in experience represent?
quests.explanation: A previously painful place becoming a place of good quiet describes a happiness that comes from healing.
quests.textToSpeak: I sat on the same beach where I'd last felt lost, and this time I just felt quiet. Good quiet.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A visible, collective silence around an object everyone sees — what unspoken event does this describe?
quests.explanation: A coat kept in place with collective silence around it silently marks an absence — a sign of collective sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: The coat still hangs by the door. Everyone can see it. Nobody mentions it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: The strongest opponent becoming the strongest advocate — what does this complete reversal produce?
quests.explanation: A complete reversal from loudest opponent to loudest champion in six weeks produces genuine surprise.
quests.textToSpeak: The person who argued most strongly against the merger became its most vocal champion six weeks later.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Two external signs of distress — an internal audio imbalance and visible pallor — twenty minutes before a pitch.
quests.explanation: An auditory perception shift and visible pallor together before a pitch are clear signs of nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: My voice sounds too loud in my own head. My colleague said I look pale. The pitch is in twenty minutes.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A midnight breakthrough before a twelve-hour countdown launch — what emotion drives the sleeplessness?
quests.explanation: Clearing the final hurdle at midnight before a launch is too exciting to sleep through.
quests.textToSpeak: We cleared the last technical hurdle at midnight. The product launches in twelve hours. I don't think anyone's slept.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Three independent witnesses with identical accounts and no connection — what pattern does this raise?
quests.explanation: Three independent, unconnected witnesses with identical accounts of the same thing produces curiosity.
quests.textToSpeak: Three separate witnesses described the same car on that road at 3 a.m., but none of them knew each other.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'I know what's needed and I know how' after fifteen years — what is the precise emotional register here?
quests.explanation: Claiming both diagnostic and delivery knowledge after fifteen years of practice is a direct statement of confidence.
quests.textToSpeak: I know what this company needs and I know how to deliver it. I've been doing it for fifteen years.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Outdated slides and a misattributed quote as the closing of an 'innovation' event — what does this signal?
quests.explanation: An innovation summit with dated content and a misattributed closing quote fails at its own premise — boredom.
quests.textToSpeak: The company's innovation summit featured slides from 2019 and closed with a motivational quote that was misattributed.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Keeping a voicemail you know you should delete but cannot — what attachment does this reveal?
quests.explanation: Keeping a voicemail despite knowing you should delete it reveals an attachment tied to grief and sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: I still have the voicemail. I know I should delete it. I haven't been able to.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Full preparation made useless by an undisclosed policy change — what emotion does the absence of notice create?
quests.explanation: An effort-demanding change implemented without notice that invalidates full preparation produces anger.
quests.textToSpeak: I arrived with all the documentation and was told the system doesn't accept physical documents anymore. No notice was given.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: The most junior finding what the most senior missed — what does this reversal of expectation produce?
quests.explanation: A junior catching a critical error that senior engineers missed defies expectation and produces surprise.
quests.textToSpeak: The least experienced person on the team spotted the critical error that three senior engineers had missed.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Authenticity replacing strategy and producing the right outcome — what emotion follows an honest risk paying off?
quests.explanation: Dropping a calculated approach for honesty and having it succeed produces relief and genuine happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: I stopped worrying about what to say and just told them honestly how I felt. It turned out to be the right decision.
